assets.direction: 竹影河岸: keep the same riverside market, add a little more soft bamboo foliage along the upper edges and far shore, quiet jade-green/teal ambient accents. Retain warm wooden deck, red neighbouring stall awnings, amber lantern light. Very restrained, not a green filter.

海风夜市: keep the same lakeside market and bridge but make the distant water a slightly clearer deep slate blue with cool moonlit atmosphere and a few pale blue distant reflections. The dry wood promenade and neighbouring red market stalls remain warmly lit. Restrained blue accents, not an ocean, beach or pirate scene.

秋夜灯会: keep the same riverside market, swap a little upper-edge foliage to gentle autumn golden osmanthus/maple leaves, muted reddish plum/amber ambient accents and a few tiny distant warm festival lights. The river remains dark blue, dry promenade honey wood, neighbouring red stalls intact. No saturated purple filter.
